Date of service: 05/24/2025 | Dr. Celine Jessop, MD (Rheumatology)

History:
63-year-old man with rheumatoid arthritis diagnosed in 2021, seen to discuss escalation of therapy. Past medical history: seasonal allergies, hypertension.

Exam:
Synovitis of the MCP and PIP joints of both hands; no rheumatoid nodules.

Treatment history:
Inadequate response to methotrexate 15 mg weekly for 29 weeks despite good adherence.

Assessment and plan:
Assessment: seropositive rheumatoid arthritis with high disease activity, CDAI 27.
Pre-biologic screening: tuberculosis and hepatitis B screens negative.
Plan: start fictimab 40 mg subcutaneously every 7 days.
